title: Conference schedule
brief: We run Frontier UX Summit, a one-day design and engineering conference in Glasgow, and we need the day one schedule page. Dark navy header and hero with an amber accent: the event name as the main heading, a small 'Day one schedule' label, and the date (Thursday 18 March 2027), the venue (Kelvin Hall, Glasgow) and '8 sessions, 3 tracks' in one row, then a 'Get your ticket' button. Next, a proper schedule table with columns Time, Session, Speaker, Room and Track: ten rows including registration and lunch, which should look quieter than the talks. Each talk shows its track as a coloured pill: Design, Engineering or Research, each with its own colour. Then a 'Featured speakers' row of three cards with initials avatars, and a dark ticket band with the early bird price of £249. Professional, energetic, easy to scan.

requirements.text: A dark navy header and hero with the heading 'Frontier UX Summit 2027' and the label 'Day one schedule'
The hero shows the date 'Thursday 18 March 2027', venue 'Kelvin Hall, Glasgow' and '8 sessions, 3 tracks', plus a 'Get your ticket' button
A schedule table with header cells Time, Session, Speaker, Room and Track
Ten rows in time order from 08:30 to 16:30, with the sessions, speakers and rooms as given
Registration and lunch rows look quieter than talk rows; talk titles are bold
Each talk's track is a rounded pill, with a different colour for Design, Engineering and Research
A 'Featured speakers' row of three cards: Ingrid Solberg, Ravi Menon and Grace Adeyemi, each with an initials avatar, role and short bio
A dark ticket band with 'Join us in Glasgow', a 'Book your ticket' button and the price £249 with 'Early bird price until 31 January 2027'
Amber is used for the label, buttons and price on the dark areas
The page uses header, main and footer, and headings in order
Text is easy to read against its background, including inside the pills

keyFacts: Interviewing users who don't want to talk
Panel: The future of product teams
Closing keynote: Small screens, big decisions
designNotes: dark navy bands at the top and the ticket section
amber accent only on dark areas
a crisp white table that is easy to scan
